label: TP
reason: Single alert java/xss is TRUE POSITIVE. User input from request.getParameterMap() flows through Base64 encode/decode cycle and reaches response.getWriter().write(bar.toCharArray()). The Base64 round-trip does not sanitize HTML special characters (< > & " ') so attacker-controlled script tags survive intact. Resolved sink value 'bar' is derived directly from user parameter 'BenchmarkTest00478', making this an exploitable XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User parameter retrieved from request.getParameterMap(), stored in param variable, processed through Base64 encode/decode, assigned to bar, then written to response writer without HTML escaping
